import json
from pathlib import Path
from slm_training.harnesses.model_build.eval_measurement import suite_result_cacheable
from slm_training.harness_core.checkpoint_bundle import validate_bundle
from slm_training.autoresearch.paired_stats import PairedSelection, paired_record_screening
base=Path("outputs/autoresearch/autonomy-mea-data-final-20260907/runs")
read=lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text())
inputs=read(Path("outputs/runs/autonomy-mea-data/final-locked-inputs.json"))
ids=inputs["selection"]["selected_record_ids"]
selection=PairedSelection(ids,dict(zip(ids,inputs["selection"]["selected_root_ids"],strict=True)))
observations={}; arms={}
for arm in ("control","candidate"):
 run=base/(arm+"-v108"); board=read(run/"scoreboard.json"); metric=read(run/"eval_smoke.json")
 assert suite_result_cacheable(metric) and board["measurement_complete"] and board["publication_complete"]
 assert metric["n"]==metric["completed_document_n"]==6 and metric["incomplete_document_n"]==0
 assert board["evals"]["runner"]["execution_errors"]==0
 assert all(Path(p).is_dir() if k=="runDir" else Path(p).is_file() for k,p in board["evals"]["artifacts"].items())
 part=read(run/"eval_smoke.partial.json"); direct=read(base/(arm+"-v108-direct")/"eval_smoke.partial.json")
 assert part["record_ids"]==direct["record_ids"]==ids and not part["pending_record_ids"]
 fields=("case_id","root_id","input_sha256","evaluator_sha256","selection_sha256","decode_seed","prediction_sha256")
 assert all(part["records"][i][k]==direct["records"][i][k] for i in ids for k in fields)
 train=read(base/arm/"train_summary.json"); checkpoint=Path(train["checkpoint"])
 validate_bundle(checkpoint.parent.parent.parent,checkpoint.parent.name)
 observations[arm]={r["id"]:r["binder_reference_f1"] for r in metric["details"]}
 arms[arm]={"selected":len(ids),"decoded":metric["completed_document_n"],"parse_rate":metric["parse_rate"],"meaningful_program_rate":metric["meaningful_program_rate"],"binder_reference_f1":metric["binder_reference_f1"],"sdk_execution_errors":0,"bundle":checkpoint.parent.name,"direct_chunk_prediction_identity_equal":True,"evaluator":metric["evaluator_sha256"]}
paired=paired_record_screening(observations["control"],observations["candidate"],direction="increase",selection=selection)
assert paired["diagnostic_complete"] and not paired["win"]
print(json.dumps({"arms":arms,"paired_binder":paired,"confirmation_complete":False,"ship_eligible":False},sort_keys=True))
